description: Four small plastic cups in yellow, red, green, and blue sit in a row on the counter, with a yellow squeeze bottle to the left and a blue scrub sponge in front. The right hand lifts and tilts the blue cup toward the center while the left hand picks up the yellow squeeze bottle and brings its nozzle to the cup’s opening, then sets the bottle down and switches to the sponge, pushing the sponge into the tilted cup and scrubbing inside as the right hand keeps holding the cup steady.
